rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you offend or insult someone.

example.english: I didn't mean to offend you by saying that.
example.traditional: 我唔係有心講呢句說話得罪你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 gong2 ne1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 dak1 zeoi6 nei5

rows.note: Use this when someone takes offense or minds what was said or done.

example.english: I hope speaking so directly doesn't offend you.
example.traditional: 我講嘢咁直接，希望你唔好介意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 je5 gam3 zik6 zip3 hei1 mong6 nei5 m4 hou2 gaai3 ji3
